name: IndiaMART InterMESH Limited
summary: IndiaMART InterMESH Limited operates an online business-to-business (B2B) marketplace for business products and services in India and internationally. The company provides an online marketplace that enables listings and discovery of businesses, products, and services; buyer-supplier matchmaking; product search and discovery; request for quotation and BuyLead services; CRM Lead Manager; web storefront solutions; cloud telephony and Premium Number Service (PNS); AI-driven matchmaking; conversational commerce; multimodal search; product specifications and price discovery tools; reviews and ratings services; business enablement software; accounting solutions; and logistics SaaS solutions.
